title: Which direction wins?
text: $$7 - 18$$ means start at 7 and move 18 units left. You pass 0, so the result is negative. A common mistake is to answer $$11$$, the distance, and drop the sign. How far is 18 from 7? That is, what is $$18 - 7$$?

title: Attach the sign
text: The larger absolute value belongs to the negative term in $$7 + (-18)$$, so take the opposite of the distance 11. What signed number has absolute value 11 and is negative?

title: Worked solution
text: $$7 - 18 = -11$$. Common mistake: answering $$11$$. General rule: if you subtract a larger positive from a smaller positive, the result is negative, and the size of the result is the difference of the absolute values.
